- Go to your bank’s official website → “Contact us” or “Lost or stolen cards.”

Since your home country is Serbia and your bank is Banca Intesa (Serbia), here’s what to do next:

1) How to find the right Banca Intesa number  
- Go to Banca Intesa Serbia’s official website.  
- Look for sections named something like:
  - “Kontakti” / “Kontakt centar”
  - “Blokada kartice” or “Gubitak / krađa kartice”
- You’re specifically looking for:
  - 24/7 number for prijava gubitka/krađe platne kartice (lost/stolen cards).
- If you have any other Banca Intesa card with you, check the back for:
  - “Call center”
  - “Prijava gubitka/krađe kartice”

Use that number immediately.

2) What to say when you call (English)  
You can read this:

“Hello, my name is [your name].  
I am a Banca Intesa customer from Serbia.  
My credit card, the Travel card ending in 7777, has been stolen.  
Please block this card immediately and issue a replacement card.  
I would also like to check recent transactions for any unauthorized charges.  
Could you please give me the reference or case number for this report  
and tell me how and where the replacement card will be delivered?”

Have ready:
- JMBG or other ID number they use,
- Your address in Serbia,
- When you last had the card and when you noticed it was missing.

3) If you prefer Serbian, you can use this phrasing  
You can adjust it to sound more natural for you:

„Dobar dan, zovem se [ime i prezime].  
Klijent sam Banca Intese iz Srbije.  
Moja kreditna kartica, putna kartica koja se završava na 7777, je ukradena.  
Molim vas da odmah blokirate ovu karticu i izdate novu karticu.  
Želeo/želela bih i da proverimo nedavne transakcije zbog mogućih zloupotreba.  
Možete li mi dati broj prijave i objasniti kako i gde će nova kartica biti isporučena?“

4) Šta da obavezno pitate operatera  
Before ending the call, ask them to confirm:
- That the card is blocked and from which exact time.
- What to do if you later see a suspicious transaction (procedure for “reklamacija transakcije / prigovor”).
- Kada i na koju adresu će nova kartica stići (i da li mogu privremeno da koristim neku digitalnu karticu u aplikaciji).

If you want, tell me how you usually access Banca Intesa (mobile app, web, or only card), and I can outline the quickest route inside their online banking/app to double-check your card status after the call.</action>
